blocks.text: Omid, whose real name cannot be used, signed up to join Iran’s security forces when he was 18 years old and harbored “a deep commitment to my country.” At the academy, Omid told DW, cadets were under the regime’s control “day and night,” from their military training through the daily prayers and speeches. “They mold the minds of the young cadets,” Omid said.
